name: Saffron City & Fighting Dojo
summary: Enter the central metropolis of Saffron City. Collect key TMs and items across town, then challenge the Fighting Dojo beside the locked Saffron Gym. Defeat Karate Master Koichi to earn your choice of a free Level 40 Fighting-type powerhouse: Hitmonlee, Hitmonchan, or Hitmontop.

items.name: TM29 Psychic
items.method: Given by Mr. Psychic in his cottage southeast of the Pokémon Center

items.name: Shiny Stone
items.method: Gift from the lady in the house southwest of the Pokémon Center

items.name: Jaw Fossil / Sail Fossil
items.method: Choice from Super Nerd Miguel after defeating him in Saffron Restaurant

items.name: Life Orb
items.method: Reward from the Police Officer in Saffron Police Station after liberating Silph Co.
